name: Registered Plan Private Investments Inc.
summary: Registered Plan Private Investments Inc. operates as a private investment platform company. Its platform allows investors to use their registered plans, including registered retirement savings plans, registered education savings plans, tax-free savings accounts, registered retirement income funds, and registered disability savings plans at their direction to invest in private companies. The company was formerly known as Lexington Biosciences, Inc. and changed its name to Registered Plan Private Investments Inc. in May 2020. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
